legal.privacyP1: MZM Case Management System is dedicated to upholding the attorney-client privilege, confidentiality, and data protection obligations applicable under the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
legal.privacyP2: We collect only data necessary for legal practice management: case citations, party names, hearing dates, court documents, and contact details. We never sell, monetize, or disclose your client data to any third party.
legal.termsP1: By registering a firm account, you agree to comply with all relevant professional standards established by the Pakistan Bar Council and applicable Provincial Bar Councils.
legal.termsP2: Subscriptions are prepaid and billed for defined terms (1, 6, or 12 months). Accounts enjoy a 3-day grace period upon expiry before editing is restricted.
legal.refundP1: Prepaid subscription fees are generally non-refundable once activated. In the event of duplicate payment or billing discrepancies, requests must be submitted within 7 days.
legal.noResultsHint: Try a different keyword or clear the search.
legal.termsLicense: MZM grants your legal practice a non-exclusive, non-transferable subscription license to utilize the case management system within the user seat limits and device boundaries established by your chosen plan.
legal.termsP3: During the 3-day grace period, all existing cases, daily cause lists, and client documents remain fully readable and searchable, but the creation or editing of records is disabled until a renewal payment is verified by our administrative team.
legal.termsEthical: Subscribers agree not to use the platform for unlawful purposes or to upload malicious content. The law firm retains ownership of all submitted case files, Vakalatnamas, and court orders.
legal.privacyAccountInfo: Law Firm Account Information: firm title, primary advocate name, email address, contact numbers, and payment verification records.
legal.privacyCaseRecords: Practice & Case Records: party names, CNIC, court bench numbers, hearing schedules, and proceedings summaries.
legal.privacyCaseDocuments: Case Documents: scanned pleadings, court orders, Vakalatnamas, and annexures uploaded to private encrypted cloud storage.
legal.privacySessionData: Security & Session Data: authorized device identifiers and timestamps used strictly to enforce seat licenses.
legal.privacyRls: Every subscriber law firm operates within a strictly segregated cryptographic tenant. Our database enforces Row Level Security (RLS) policies at the PostgreSQL engine level, ensuring that no advocate, clerk, or third-party from another firm can query, read, or modify your confidential client matters.
legal.privacyRetention: In compliance with global data privacy standards, law firms retain absolute control over their records. Account holders may permanently erase their account, profiles, cases, and associated document artifacts at any time directly through the in-app Settings menu.
legal.refundTrial: Every newly registered law firm receives a complimentary 7-day trial with full access to all features, including case management, calendar cause lists, reminder alerts, and document storage. We encourage thorough evaluation of the system during this trial period prior to committing to a paid plan.
legal.refundDuplicate: If a duplicate deposit was made due to bank network delays or incorrect transaction reference submissions, please contact our support desk via WhatsApp or email with your payment receipts. Once verified by our super admin, duplicate funds will be refunded to the original account within 5 to 7 business days.
